{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An uncommon but cheap '''fungus''' had properties that caused addiction in the population of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Shesharile 5]] and [[Shesharile 6]]. The [[drug dealer]] [[Shlith-dan]] discovered the [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] and subsequently introduced it on the [[Twin Planets|two moons]], as a result exacerbating their economic depression.<ref name="GG62">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>
